problems.problem: The previous hard formwork seams at y≈410 and y≈1010 are gone (visible improvement), but the regenerated plane now reads as a cyclorama studio sweep: a soft coved wall-to-floor transition arcs across the frame at y≈700-780, passing exactly behind the bottle's shoulder-to-neck junction (product_bbox top 418, shoulder ≈740). The declared concept is a monumental flat cast-concrete wall ('architectural void'), not a photographed studio corner; the curved sweep collapses the monument read into generic packshot scenery and cuts the silhouette at its narrowest point.

Contact detail crop [259,1171,821,1421] confirms a real contact shadow at offset_y 0 (correct, do not move down), and the opacity/blur increase is visible versus the previous pale smudge. However the occlusion core still spans only roughly the middle 60% of the 402 px base footprint and fades before the corners, while the floor immediately below stays uniformly light; under the declared broad soft frontal light a monument-scale object should cast a footprint-wide core with a slightly broader soft penumbra. The bottle therefore sits 'lightly' rather than with mass.

References 3-5 wrap the hero in environment light (Diptyque's reflected ceiling glow, Hermès's atmospheric dust, Prada's matched studio wrap). Here the dark glass edges carry warm studio highlights that do not respond to the cool #9aa0a4 ambient, and the wall shows no luminance reaction (no subtle brightening or falloff) around the hero, so the bottle still reads as a clean cut-out placed on a plane; this is the largest remaining quality gap to the campaign references.

Hierarchy is now disciplined (logo 26 / title 72 / subtitle 24, tight block, text_product_overlap all false), but the brief's copper accent line under the title renders as a near-black hairline and the palette accent #b0762a never appears anywhere in the type or layout, so the declared three-color monument grid is only two colors in execution.

changes.value: Monolithic flat raw cast concrete wall in cool grey, perfectly continuous matte mineral surface with no seams, no joints, no corner and no floor sweep, very subtle broad radial luminance falloff softly brighter behind the center of the plane, even diffuse frontal illumination with cool ambient wrap, empty architectural void
